villageLost.beat: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

deaths.who: a red moon rising between the trees, breathing

Overnight, Stinging Nettle went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
👀 Someone asks Jorge a shop-talk question about HVAC tech work. The pause before the answer is long enough to hear.
🔥 “I don’t say this lightly.” Nganga sets their bowl down. “Chloe, your past story isn’t true, is it? I’ve heard enough versions now.” Nobody looks at Chloe. Everybody does.
Rowan Goldstein reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
You are full enough.
The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
"You haven't earned that yet," Willie says. (Trust too low.)

"Oh! OH! You're starting to GET it! The audience loves the little ah-ha moments! The odds just shifted!"
